Hinweis.Attribute: Base 1, 12 free points. Own points up to 4, with bonuses 5, through experience 6.
Hinweis.Fertigkeiten: 25 free points. Class core skills +1, subclass bonuses and basic training (•) +1 to Dodge, Mental Resistance and Perception are calculated automatically. Without the skill you roll white dice only.
Hinweis.Kraefte: Costs are paid on use, even on failure. Missing points become stress. On a fumble the sheet rolls Backlash or Crystal Crack.
Hinweis.Schaden: Damage = weapon damage + excess − target's armour. With a targeted token, defence and armour are taken over and life points are deducted.
Hinweis.Pools: Pools as “white + coloured”, e.g. assault rifle 3 + 3, damage 4. Damage 0 = normal check. Rule of thumb: mook 2 + 2, pro 3 + 3, elite 4 + 4, leader 5 + 5.
Hinweis.Rang: This category requires the rank {rang}. Cast anyway?
Hinweis.Aufgefuellt: {name}: life points, PSI and magic energy restored.
Hinweis.Kreise: hatched: subclass bonus · dashed circle: maximum 6, only through experience
Hinweis.FertLegende: ◆ core skill · G basic training · last column: white + coloured dice
Hinweis.Fuss: White dice (attribute) succeed on 5+ · coloured dice (skill) on 4+ · Easy 1 · Doable 2 · Hard 3 · Very hard 4 · Impossible 5

Warnung.AttrSumme: {n} own attribute points (12 at creation, more only through experience).
Warnung.FertSumme: {n} own skill points (25 at creation, more only through experience).
Warnung.NurPsion: Psionic skills are for Psions only.
Warnung.NurThaumaturg: Magic skills are for Thaumaturges only.
Warnung.Subklasse: The subclass does not belong to the class.
Warnung.Rang: With {ep} XP the rank {rang} is due.

Dialog.Hinweis: Bonus dice are white (at most +3). Penalty dice remove white dice first, then coloured dice.
Dialog.Knoten: Matching class tree nodes (enter bonus yourself):

Grauen.Patzer: Loses the next action: freezes, screams or flees.
Grauen.TraumaText: {text} Stress drops to {neu}. The player may choose a trauma instead of rolling.

Karte.Verzweiflung: empty pool: desperation roll, only a 6 counts

Kampf.Grandios: Critical, choose one effect: armour does not count ({n} damage), disarm or knock back 2 m, take the next action away, or a second target suffers {w} damage.
Kampf.Patzer: Jam, stuck blade, stumble (defence 1) or an ally is hit.

Rueckkopplung.3: Nosebleed and cramps: 2 damage, armour does not count (applied).
Rueckkopplung.4: Nosebleed and cramps: 2 damage, armour does not count (applied).
Rueckkopplung.5: Misdirection: the power hits another target of the GM's choice.
Rueckkopplung.6: Burnt out: no psi powers for one hour.

Kristallriss.3: Recoil: 2 damage, armour does not count (applied).
Kristallriss.4: Misfire: the spell affects another target of the GM's choice.
Kristallriss.5: Crack in the crystal: −1 die on all spells until the crystal is replaced or healed in a ritual.
Kristallriss.6: Reality flicker: something notices the thaumaturge. The GM may introduce a supernatural complication later in the mission.

Trauma.1: Nightmares: −1 die on all checks the day after a sleepless night.
Trauma.2: Phobia: −2 dice while the trigger is near (darkness, blood, crystals …).
Trauma.3: Paranoia: −2 dice on Persuasion and Leadership; trusts no one.
Trauma.4: Compulsion: must perform a ritual (check the weapon, count doors), otherwise −1 die.
Trauma.5: Numbness: −1 die on all social checks; seems cold and absent.
Trauma.6: Flashbacks: under stress a horror check against Easy (1), otherwise incapacitated for one round.

Preis.Anlass: Reason to roll the price ({preis}). The GM rolls in secret.

Text.Agent: The agent loses the thread for a moment.
Text.Scientist: The sample has left something behind.
Text.Investigator: He sees a pattern. Whether it is real, he does not know.

Regel.Psion: +1 per node of the overload branch, never decreases. d6 on overload or psi fumble: equal or lower, and something is listening.
Regel.Thaumaturg: +1 per node of the centre, +1 per nexus or northern-light stone kept overnight. d6 on centre, overdraw or fumble: equal or lower, and the stone answers.
Regel.Soldier: Pieces minus 4, from 5 pieces. d6 on a failed horror check or 0 LP against beings from rifts: equal or lower, and the silver answers.
Regel.Agent: Legends beyond the first, +1 per node IV or V in the false bottom. d6 on a fumbled Deception or Disguise or stress within a legend.
Regel.Scientist: Samples in prototypes, +1 per node V. d6 on a fumble with supernatural material or a prototype malfunction with a sample.
Regel.Investigator: Files with at least three threads, +1 per card of level V. d6 on an Investigation fumble or a failed horror check at a crime scene.

Preis.AutoHinweis: Circles up to {n} come from signature and class tree. Click further circles for events in play.

Gegner.GrauenHinweis: Every agent rolls WIL + Mental Resistance (button “Horror Check” on the sheet).
